scenarios.detail: The speed layer drops events later than the 2-minute watermark and cuts its 1-minute windows on real event_time, which does not align exactly with the simulated-day boundary used by the batch layer. The batch layer recomputes from the complete Parquet partition and is the figure the business uses.
